scope: Both archives retain every raw measurement/per-turn/process counter/provider request, adverse and failed result, compiler/preflight monitor, build/helper identity, verification record and backup hash. Full includes every one of 2080 consistent native backups. Portable includes first/last representative DBs, not every image. Product ELF/dependency trees and private/live runtime/workspace roots are excluded; originals remain locally. Census requested allocations and ordinary PSS/CPU/writes remain separate.
